caption: The spark fires at 15° before TDC. Pressure first rises at 12° after TDC, the main flame sweep ends at 42°, and the slow afterburning tail ends at 62°.

spec.aria: Timeline from 15 degrees before top dead centre to 62 degrees after top dead centre: ignition lag ends at 12 degrees after TDC, flame propagation ends at 42 degrees, and afterburning ends at 62 degrees.
